title: agropyron sibiricum
intro: Agropyron sibiricum, commonly known as Siberian wheatgrass, is a type of perennial grass native to the mountainous regions of Siberia. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and anti-cancer activities. The therapeutic actions of Siberian wheatgrass include reducing oxidative stress, protecting against cell damage, and promoting wound healing. Bioactive constituents of Siberian wheatgrass include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
